name: hypermove-app
description: hypermove.xyz — make any web3 dApp agent-callable in 3 lines of HTML. Funded under GOAT AI Builder Grants.

_dep_justifications.pg: Node.js Postgres driver. Drives Supabase registry storage via Server Action in src/app/portal/actions.ts. Single peer; ~50KB; mature.
_dep_justifications.@next/mdx: Required for /docs/* MDX content. Official Next.js plugin.
_dep_justifications.remark-gfm: Enables GitHub-Flavored-Markdown tables/strikethrough/task-lists in @next/mdx's remark pipeline (next.config.mjs) — without it, pipe-table syntax in /docs/*.mdx compiles as literal paragraph text, not a <table>. Used at Next.js build time (next.config.mjs), so it must be a real dependency, not devDependency.
_dep_justifications.rehype-pretty-code: Adds Shiki-based syntax highlighting to fenced code blocks across /docs/*.mdx via @next/mdx's rehype pipeline (next.config.mjs). Build-time dependency, same reasoning as remark-gfm.
_dep_justifications.shiki: Peer of rehype-pretty-code — the actual highlighting engine (TextMate grammars, VS Code themes). Build-time dependency.
_dep_justifications.@testing-library/react: Required for component tests under /tests/components. Industry standard.
_dep_justifications.xrpl: n-payment@0.30.1's optional peer dep for XRPL support (>=4.0.0, lazy-imported — see node_modules/.pnpm/n-payment.../package.json peerDependenciesMeta). Only exercised by scripts/demo-t54-rlusd-dream-cycle.ts's RLUSD_DEMO_MODE=live path (real testnet Payment/TrustSet submission + ledger validation) and its test double; the Next.js app itself never imports it. Exact-pinned devDependency, not bundled into any route.

_pnpm_overrides_justifications.@xrplf/isomorphic>@noble/hashes: 2026-08-12, docs/prd/2026-08-12-fix-rlusd-payment-rail-esm-crash.md. @xrplf/isomorphic@1.0.2 (a real dependency of xrpl@5.0.0, which n-payment's XRPL settlement path lazy-imports at runtime — see settleXrplRlusd()/settleXrplAlreadySubmitted() in src/lib/mcp/npayment-rails.ts) declares @noble/hashes: ^2.0.1, which always resolved to the newest 2.x line (2.2.0). @noble/hashes@2.x is published type:module with zero CJS build, and @xrplf/isomorphic's own bundled CJS output does a plain require() of it — a real Node module-resolution crash confirmed live against every XRPL settlement attempt regardless of proof correctness. SCOPED to only @xrplf/isomorphic's resolution (not a blanket override) because @scure/bip39@2.2.0 (used by n-payment's own wallet-signing path, transitively) pins @noble/hashes to an EXACT '2.2.0' and imports the '@noble/hashes/webcrypto.js' subpath, which only exists in 2.x's exports map — a blanket 1.8.0 override was tried first and broke that path with a DIFFERENT ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED crash, confirmed live via the RUN_LIVE_XRPL_TESTS=true Tier 2 test in tests/mcp-xrpl-settlement.test.ts. The scoped `pkg>dep` override syntax pins @noble/hashes only where @xrplf/isomorphic itself resolves it, leaving @scure/bip39's exact 2.2.0 pin (and everything else in the tree) untouched. Remove this override only once @xrplf/isomorphic ships a release that either re-pins to a compatible @noble/hashes range or fixes its own require()->import() call — verify via the same live Tier 2 test before removing.
_pnpm_overrides_justifications.ripple-address-codec>@scure/base: 2026-08-12, same PRD, found live in production AFTER the @noble/hashes fix above was deployed — same bug class, different link in the same xrpl@5.0.0 dependency chain. ripple-address-codec@5.0.1 (a real, non-peer dependency of @xrplf/isomorphic@1.0.2, reached via XRPL address encode/decode — e.g. deriving a classic address from a seed during wallet signing) declares @scure/base: 2.2.0 (published type:module, zero CJS build — same ESM-only migration pattern as @noble/hashes@2.x). The live crash: `require() of ES Module .../@scure+base@2.2.0/.../index.js from .../ripple-address-codec@5.0.1/.../xrp-codec.js not supported`. Pinned to @scure/base@1.2.6 (already present in the lockfile, confirmed CJS via main:'./lib/index.js' with no type:module, and already the version other consumers in this tree resolve without issue) — scoped only to ripple-address-codec's own resolution to avoid repeating the earlier blanket-override mistake.
_pnpm_overrides_justifications.ripple-keypairs>@noble/curves: 2026-08-12, same PRD, fixed preemptively alongside the @scure/base fix above rather than waiting for a third live crash: ripple-keypairs@3.0.0 (used for XRPL seed-to-keypair derivation, i.e. wallet signing — the exact code path that was about to be exercised next) declares @noble/curves: 2.2.0 (same package.json shape as the other two: type:module, zero CJS build). Pinned to @noble/curves@1.9.7 (already present in the lockfile at a confirmed-CJS version, main:'index.js' with no type:module) — scoped only to ripple-keypairs's own resolution.
_pnpm_overrides_justifications.xrpl>@scure/bip39: 2026-08-17, docs/feedback/2026-08-17-start-dream-4th-esm-cjs-crash-scure-bip39.md — a 4th LIVE instance, first exercised once the xrpl_rlusd payment-config gate was fixed and a real settlement attempt finally reached xrpl@5.0.0's Wallet/index.js (seed/mnemonic wallet derivation during settlement verification). UNLIKE the other 3 instances in this list, a version override to any CJS-compatible @scure/bip39@1.x release does NOT fix this one — verified live via node -e "require('xrpl').Wallet.generate()" after trying a 1.6.0 override first: it trades the original 'require() of ES Module' crash for a DIFFERENT crash, ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED on './wordlists/english.js', because xrpl@5.0.0's own COMPILED CJS code does require("@scure/bip39/wordlists/english.js") — a .js-suffixed subpath that only @scure/bip39@2.x's exports map defines (1.x's exports map uses the un-suffixed "./wordlists/english" path instead, a real breaking exports-shape change between major versions, not just an ESM/CJS build-target difference). Every 2.x release (2.0.0 through 2.3.0, checked via npm view) is ESM-only (type:module, no CJS build, source-level import syntax in index.js) with no dual-package escape hatch. Fixed via a pnpm patch (patches/@scure__bip39@2.3.0.patch — 2.3.0 is what xrpl@5.0.0's semver range actually resolves to) instead of a version override: (1) built a real CJS bundle via esbuild for index.js and every wordlists/*.js file into a new cjs/ subdirectory with its own {type:'commonjs'} package.json (required — the parent's type:module would otherwise force every .js file to parse as ESM); (2) deferred the one require() the bundler can't tree-shake (@noble/hashes/webcrypto.js, used only by mnemonicToSeedWebcrypto, never called by xrpl@5.0.0's Wallet module per a repo-wide grep) into a lazy first-call loader, since @noble/hashes@1.8.0 has no webcrypto.js subpath at all; (3) added dual require/import/default conditions to package.json's exports map, preserving every subpath NAME unchanged. Verified end-to-end against the real installed tree: generateMnemonic/validateMnemonic/mnemonicToSeedSync/mnemonicToSeedWebcrypto all resolve as functions, a real 128-bit mnemonic round-trips through generate to validate, mnemonicToSeedSync produces a genuine 64-byte seed. Requires the companion @scure/bip39>@noble/hashes override below. Remove both once xrpl re-pins to a @scure/bip39 range with a real dual CJS/ESM build — verify via the live Tier 2 test (RUN_LIVE_XRPL_TESTS=true) before removing, and replay txHash 59B4F5A720E3657AA01BE4A5766BD4658EAEAC9E2CDFA8089DF734483BAF5ECF (the real, still-valid, tesSUCCESS 0.05 RLUSD payment from the feedback series) as the first live confirmation this crash is actually gone in production.
_pnpm_overrides_justifications.@scure/bip39>@noble/hashes: 2026-08-17, companion to the xrpl>@scure/bip39 patch above. @scure/bip39@2.3.0 (what xrpl@5.0.0 actually resolves) depends on @noble/hashes@2.3.0 — ESM-only, zero CJS build, same pattern as every other override in this list. The generated CJS build's bundled require() calls (require('@noble/hashes/pbkdf2.js'), sha2.js, utils.js) need a CJS-compatible sibling to resolve; @noble/hashes@1.8.0 (already pinned for @xrplf/isomorphic and every other consumer in this list) provides require conditions for all three subpaths. Scoped to @scure/bip39>@noble/hashes (pnpm's override selector only supports one level of parent scoping, so xrpl>@scure/bip39>@noble/hashes is invalid — confirmed via a live ERR_PNPM_INVALID_SELECTOR) rather than a blanket @noble/hashes override; grepped the lockfile first to confirm @scure/bip39 has no other version in the tree that this scope would wrongly catch. Note: @noble/hashes@1.8.0 has no './webcrypto.js' subpath — the patch's CJS build defers that one require to first-call rather than needing it resolvable at module-load time, since mnemonicToSeedWebcrypto is never called by anything in this dependency graph today.
